answer: Histories are stored in fable, checked in ripple, and delta shows each void. A farm cannot present clean aliases because the record follows the key, so laundering reputation through new keys does not work. Each identity publishes its full failure history, and hiding 7 or more junk verdicts voids its standing entirely when discovered. A farm of 3775 identities would post 1956 proofs and burn roughly 86 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
